thread:
mika (CS): Heads-up — ParcelX onboarding: intermittent 403s from our Node SDK only after they route through their new edge proxy. They have a renewal conversation in ~2 weeks. Can we triage quickly?

jason (eng): Do we have a minimal repro and raw response bodies? 403s could be dropped headers, wrong client id, or mis-applied scopes.

mika (CS): Repro steps they shared: deploy a Lambda that does `const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: RW_KEY }); await c.generate({ model: 'gpt-x', prompt: 'hello' })`. Warmup requests succeed, later requests randomly fail 403. Logs below: 

parcelx-onboard-bot: [2026-02-15T09:12:12Z] req=01 auth=ok status=200
parcelx-onboard-bot: [2026-02-15T09:12:15Z] req=02 auth=missing status=403

mika (CS): Example 403 payload they forwarded: `{\"error\":\"unauthorized\",\"reason\":\"Authorization header missing after redirect\"}`

jason (eng): That message screams \"auth header dropped on redirect\". Node HTTP libs (and fetch implementations) often drop Authorization on cross-host 3xx to prevent credential leakage. Do they redirect to a different host?

mika (CS): Yes — their edge returns a 307 that points to a regional gateway host. First few requests hit same host => ok; subsequent ones get routed to regional host -> header gone -> 403.

olga (support-engineer): Node SDK uses node-fetch with default redirect:'follow' which won't preserve Authorization when Location is cross-origin. We see this periodically with proxies that do internal 307s.

jason (eng): Quick check we recommend to customers: `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer X\" https://their-edge/redirect` and watch whether Authorization header is forwarded by the edge or dropped by client.

mika (CS): ParcelX tried curl and reproduced: when curl follows redirect it doesn't forward Authorization to new host. Their ops asked for immediate mitigation — renewal could slip if prod flaps.

olga (support-engineer): Two practical workarounds:
1) Edge change (recommended): configure proxy to proxy_pass internally instead of issuing 307, or explicitly forward Authorization across redirects. For nginx: `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;`
2) SDK/client change (short-term): set the SDK to do redirect: 'manual' so it receives the 3xx and then re-issues the request including Authorization to the new Location. We expose debug env `REDWOOD_HTTP_REDIRECT=manual` for this exact scenario.

jason (eng): I'll make a tiny Node SDK change: when redirect target is cross-host, re-issue request with the original Authorization header instead of relying on fetch's auto-follow. I'll open a PR and add integration tests for 307 flows.

mika (CS): ParcelX applied the nginx header line in staging. After ~25 minutes of traffic they reported zero 403s. They plan a prod deploy tonight. I added the account health note and escalated to renewal manager to push decision a week.

olga (support-engineer): I left a debugging snippet for ParcelX to test manual redirect if they can't change the edge quickly: 
```js
process.env.REDWOOD_HTTP_REDIRECT = 'manual';
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await c._httpClient.request({ method: 'POST', path: '/v1/generate' });
if (res.status === 307) {
  const loc = res.headers.get('location');
  // re-issue to loc with same Authorization header
}
```

jason (eng): PR #4832 opened: Node SDK preserve-auth-on-redirect. Tests added; target patch release tomorrow.

mika (CS): ParcelX staging: `parcelx-onboard-bot: [2026-02-15T10:02:00Z] staging: 3600s no 403s observed` — they look good.

\mjason (eng): After patch lands we'll cut a patch release and update docs: onboarding troubleshooting -> \"Proxies & redirects may drop Authorization headers\" with nginx/ALB examples.

olga (support-engineer): I told ParcelX we prefer the proxy fix; they'll still apply SDK workaround if prod shows any flakiness. I'll follow up tomorrow morning and capture a short quote about how the docs helped for our onboarding playbook.

mika (CS): Logged account health note: \"Auth header lost across 307 from edge -> regional host. Staging fixed via nginx proxy_set_header; Node SDK patch pending (PR #4832). Monitoring prod rollout; renewal decision deferred one week.\" :thumbsup:

parcelx-onboard-bot: [2026-02-15T21:30:00Z] prod: initial 60m no 403s after edge config

mika (CS): Closing thread — prod looks healthy. If ParcelX sees new issues we'll reopen and escalate to SRE for gateway routing changes.
